notes: Public Paint Tools Studio release. Carries over the full v3.5.0-beta.6 drawing toolkit: selections, magic wand, move tools, gradients, clone, recolor, text, shapes, transformations and history, alongside Wardrobe Studio custom zones, poses, and transparent PNG export. Includes prior beta undo/redo and character-guide fitting changes. Main-branch URLs and update caches. No changes to wardrobe artwork, masks, or default fitting.
